svg.title: A native test can be the useful result
svg.desc: Pyee native test audit, 26 October 2026. The original 53 tests pass on both correct source and one deliberate remove-after-callback mutation. Adding one reentrant-once test gives 54 passing tests on correct source and detects the mutation. No current upstream bug, adoption, speedup or general coverage score is claimed.

g.text: A native test can be the useful result.
Maintainer feedback → inspect existing coverage → propose one pytest test
Original suite → suite plus native candidate
Original 53 pass; added test fails as intended
No new upstream dependency. No runner needed for the native test.
One controlled case, not a current pyee bug or a general coverage score. Candidate awaits review.
